responses.english:
*Pregnancy Stages*

*First Trimester (Weeks 1–12):*
• Baby's organs begin forming
• Morning sickness is common
• Visit clinic to confirm pregnancy
• Start folic acid supplements

*Second Trimester (Weeks 13–26):*
• Baby moves — you will feel kicks!
• Energy returns for most women
• ANC visits at weeks 20 and 26
• Ultrasound scan recommended

*Third Trimester (Weeks 27–40):*
• Baby gains weight rapidly
• Plan your delivery location now
• ANC visits at weeks 30, 34, 36 and 38
• Watch for danger signs

WHO recommends 8 ANC visits total.

Would you like to know about danger signs, nutrition, or clinic visits?
responses.shona:
*Matanho Emimba*

*Trimester Yekutanga (Masvondo 1–12):*
• Nhengo dzemuviri wemwana dzinotanga kuumbwa
• Kurwara mangwanani kunowanikwa
• Enda kuchipatara kusimbisa mimba
• Tanga kutora folic acid

*Trimester Yechipiri (Masvondo 13–26):*
• Mwana anotanga kusimudza — uchamunzwa!
• Simba rinodzoka kune vakadzi vazhinji
• Enda kuANC pamasvondo 20 na 26
• Scan inokurudzirwa

*Trimester Yechitatu (Masvondo 27–40):*
• Mwana anokura nekukurumidza
• Ronga nzvimbo yekubereka iye zvino
• Enda kuANC pamasvondo 30, 34, 36 na 38
• Tarisa zviratidzo zvengozi

WHO inokurudzira kushanyira ANC kangumi nesere munguva yose yemimba.

Uda kuziva nezve zviratidzo zvengozi, chikafu, kana kuchipatara?
responses.ndebele:
*Izigaba Zokukhulelwa*

*Isigaba Sokuqala (Amasonto 1–12):*
• Izitho zengane ziqala ukwakhiwa
• Ukugula ekuseni kuvamile
• Ya esibhedlela ukuqinisekisa ukukhulelwa
• Qala ukuthatha i-folic acid

*Isigaba Sesibili (Amasonto 13–26):*
• Ingane iqala ukukhahla — uzakuzwa!
• Amandla abuyela kwabesifazane abanengi
• Vakasha i-ANC emasvondweni 20 le 26
• I-scan ikhuthazwa

*Isigaba Sesithathu (Amasonto 27–40):*
• Ingane ikhula ngokushesha
• Hlela indawo yokubeletha manje
• Vakasha i-ANC emasvondweni 30, 34, 36 le 38
• Qaphela izibonakaliso zengozi

I-WHO ikhukhaza ukuvakasha i-ANC izikhathi eziyisishiyagalombili phakathi nokukhulelwa.

Funa ukwazi ngezibonakaliso zengozi, ukudla, noma ukuvakasha esibhedlela?

responses.english:
*DANGER SIGNS IN PREGNANCY*

Go to clinic IMMEDIATELY if you have:

• Heavy bleeding from vagina
• Severe headache that won't go away
• Blurred or double vision
• Swollen face, hands or feet
• Fits or convulsions
• High fever (above 38°C)
• Baby not moving for 12+ hours
• Severe stomach pain
• Water breaking before 37 weeks
• Fainting or loss of consciousness

Do NOT wait — these signs are emergencies!

Call your nearest clinic or Village Health Worker immediately.

Are you experiencing any of these symptoms right now?
responses.shona:
*ZVIRATIDZO ZVENGOZI MUMIMBA*

Enda kuchipatara NEKUKURUMIDZA kana une:

• Kubuda ropa rakawanda nezasi
• Kurwadziwa kwakaipa kwakanyanya musoro
• Kuona zvisina kujeka kana kaviri
• Kuzvimba kumeso, maoko kana tsoka
• Maririzano kana muviri kushamba
• Tembiricha yakakwira (pamusoro pa 38°C)
• Mwana asingazosimudzi maawa 12 kana kupfuura
• Kurwadziwa kwakaipa muchiuno
• Mvura kuputika basa asati atanga kusvika 37
• Kupera simba kana kurasika pfungwa

USAMIRA — izvi ndezvengozi!

Fona chipatara chiri pedyo kana VHW wako nekukurumidza.

Une rimwe rezvimhu izvi iye zvino here?
responses.ndebele:
*IZIBONAKALISO ZENGOZI NGESIKHATHI SOKULINDA*

Ya esibhedlela NGOKUSHESHA uma ulezitho lezi:

• Igazi elinengi livela phansi
• Inhloko ebuhlungu kakhulu engayi
• Ukubona ngokungacaci noma kabili
• Ubuso, izandla noma inyawo zivuvukile
• Ukuqaqamba noma ukuthuthumela
• Umzimba oshisayo (ngaphezu kuka-38°C)
• Ingane ingasimukanga amahora angu-12 noma ngaphezulu
• Ubuhlungu obufayo esiswini
• Amanzi ephuka ngaphambi kwamasonto angu-37
• Ukudangala noma ukulahlekelwa yizwi

UNGALINDANGI — lezi zizibonakaliso zezimo eziphuthumayo!

Shayela isibhedlela esiseduze noma uMsebenzi Wezempilo Emzini ngokushesha.

Ulezitho lezi manje?

responses.english:
*Nutrition During Pregnancy*

*Foods to eat every day:*
• Dark green vegetables — rape, covo, spinach
• Orange vegetables — sweet potato, pumpkin, carrots
• Beans, lentils and groundnuts — protein
• Lean meat, fish and eggs — protein and iron
• Fruits — banana, mango, orange, guava
• Milk and yoghurt — calcium for strong bones
• Sadza, rice, bread — energy

*Supplements your nurse will give you:*
• Folic acid — prevents birth defects (take from start)
• Iron tablets — prevents anaemia and weakness
• Take every day without missing

*Foods to AVOID:*
• Raw or undercooked meat and eggs
• Unpasteurised milk
• Alcohol — harmful to baby at any stage
• Too much salt and sugar

*Breastfeeding:*
Breast milk is best for the first 6 months. Feed on demand, 8–12 times a day. No water, tea or formula needed.

Would you like advice about clinic visits or danger signs?
responses.shona:
*Chikafu Chekudya Panguva Yemimba*

*Chikafu chekudya zuva rega rega:*
• Miriwo yakasviba — muriwo, covo, spinach
• Miriwo yemichero — batata rinotsvuka, mbeyu, magaro
• Nyemba, mbogo negunguwo — protein
• Nyama, hove namazai — protein nesimbi
• Michero — bhanana, mango, chirimwe, gwava
• Mukaka na yoghurt — calcium yemapfupa akasimba
• Sadza, raisi, chingwa — simba

*Mishonga inokupiwa nenesi yako:*
• Folic acid — indzivirira matambudziko ekuberekwa
• Mapiritsi esimbi — anodzivirira anaemia
• Ida zuva rega rega usasiya

*Chikafu CHOKUZIVISA:*
• Nyama yakabiwa zvisina kukwana namazai
• Mukaka usina kuiswa zvikamu
• Doro — rinokuvadza mwana pamatanho ose
• Munyu namuswero zvakanyanya

*Kuchengeta mazamu:*
Mukaka wemazamu ndiwo wakanakira mwana kwemasvondo 6 ekutanga. Muchipishe nguva dzose, kamwe 8–12 pazuva. Hapana mvura, tii kana formula inodikanwa.

Uda mazano ekuchipatara kana zviratidzo zvengozi?
responses.ndebele:
*Ukudla Ngesikhathi Sokulinda*

*Ukudla okudingekayo nsuku zonke:*
• Imifino eluhlaza — umriwo, covo, spinach
• Imifino emthubi — ubhatata, ithanga, amakharothi
• Ubhontshisi, indumba negadanga — amandla
• Inyama, inhlanzi lamaqanda — amandla lesibili
• Izithelo — ubhanana, umango, lamula, igwava
• Ubisi le-yoghurt — ikhaliziamu yamathambo
• Isiduli, ilayisi, isinkwa — amandla

*Imithi umeluleki wakho azakunika yona:*
• I-folic acid — ivimbela izinkinga zokuzalwa
• Amaphilisi esibili — avimbela i-anaemia
• Thatha nsuku zonke ungashiyi

*Ukudla OKUFANELE UKUPHEPHA:*
• Inyama lamaqanda angaphekwanga ngokwaneleyo
• Ubisi obunga-pasteurised
• Utshwala — kuyingozi enganeni nganoma isiphi isigaba
• Usawoti loshukela okunengi

*Ukuncelisa:*
Ubisi lwesifuba lungcono kuze kube izinyanga eziyisithupha. Ncelisa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, izikhathi eziyisishiyagalombili kuya eziyishumi nambili ngosuku. Akunamanzi, itiye noma i-formula edingekayo.

Funa ulwazi ngokuvakasha esibhedlela noma izibonakaliso zengozi?

responses.english:
*Antenatal Care (ANC) Visit Schedule*

WHO recommends 8 visits:

• Week 8 — confirm pregnancy, blood tests, start supplements
• Week 12 — check growth, HIV test
• Week 20 — scan, check baby position
• Week 26 — blood pressure, weight
• Week 30 — anaemia check, tetanus injection
• Week 34 — baby position, birth plan
• Week 36 — final check before delivery
• Week 38 — delivery preparation

*What to bring to every visit:*
• Your ANC card — never forget it!
• Your ID
• Any medicines you are taking

*At every visit you will get:*
• Blood pressure check
• Weight measurement
• Urine test
• Iron and folic acid tablets

Reply with your town or district to find the nearest clinic.
responses.shona:
*Chirongwa Chekushanyira ANC*

WHO inokurudzira kushanyira kanominwe:

• Svondo 8 — simbisa mimba, bvunzo dzemaropa, tanga mishonga
• Svondo 12 — tarisa kukura kwemwana, bvunzo yaHIV
• Svondo 20 — scan, tarisa nzvimbo yemwana
• Svondo 26 — tembiricha yegopa, uzito
• Svondo 30 — bvunzo yeanemia, injection yetetanasi
• Svondo 34 — nzvimbo yemwana, chirongwa chekubereka
• Svondo 36 — tarisa yekupedzisira
• Svondo 38 — kurukura nezvekubereka

*Zvinofanira kuenda nazvo:
• ANC card yako — usaibvira!
• ID yako
• Mishonga yaunodya

*Pazushanyiro dzose uchapiwa:
• Tarisa tembiricha yegopa
• Kurongerwa uzito
• Bvunzo yemuchena
• Mapiritsi esimbi nefolic acid

Nyora taundi kana dunhu rako kuti tiwane chipatara chiri pedyo nawe.
responses.ndebele:
*Uhlelo Lwezivakasho Ze-ANC*

I-WHO ikhuthaza izivakasho eziyisishiyagalombili:

• Isonto 8 — qinisekisa ukukhulelwa, imihlolo yegazi, qala imithi
• Isonto 12 — hlola ukukhula kwengane, uhlolo lwe-HIV
• Isonto 20 — i-scan, hlola indawo yengane
• Isonto 26 — ingcindezi yegazi, isisindo
• Isonto 30 — uhlolo lwe-anaemia, umjovo we-tetanus
• Isonto 34 — indawo yengane, uhlelo lokubeletha
• Isonto 36 — ukuhlolwa kokuphela
• Isonto 38 — ukulungiselela ukubeletha

*Okudingeka ekuvakasheni:
• Ikhadi lakho le-ANC — ungalokhu ukhohlwa!
• Imvume yakho yobuzwe
• Noma imiphi imithi oyithathayo

*Ekuvakasheni ngakunye uzathola:
• Ukuhlolwa kwengcindezi yegazi
• Ukulinganiswa kwesisindo
• Uhlolo lwamangcolosi
• Amaphilisi esibili le-folic acid

Bhala idolobha noma isifunda sakho ukuze sithole isibhedlela esiseduze.

responses.english:
*Labour and Delivery*

*Signs Labour is Starting:*
• Regular contractions every 5–10 minutes, getting stronger
• Water breaking — clear fluid from below
• Bloody show — pink or red mucus
• Strong lower back pain
• Strong urge to push down

*Stages of Labour:*
1 — Early labour: contractions every 5–10 min
2 — Active labour: contractions every 2–3 min
3 — Pushing — baby is born
4 — Placenta is delivered

*Go to clinic IMMEDIATELY if:*
• Water breaks before 37 weeks
• Heavy bleeding at any time
• Baby stops moving
• Very severe pain

Always deliver at a health facility — NEVER alone at home.

*Pack for the clinic:*
• ANC card and ID
• Baby clothes and blanket
• Your own clothes and towel
• Money for transport home

Would you like to know about newborn care after delivery?
responses.shona:
*Kubereka*

*Zviratidzo zvekutanga kwemubereko:*
• Kurwadziwa kunowirirana kamwe ne kamwe maawa mashoma, kwozoitika kakawanda
• Mvura kuputika — mvura yakajeka kubuda pasi
• Ropa duku pamucherechedzo — mucus youni kana youni tsvuku
• Kurwadziwa kwakaipa musana wepasi
• Kuda kununura zvikuru

*Matanho Ekubereka:*
1 — Kutanga kubereka: kurwadziwa kamwe ne kamwe masvondo 5–10
2 — Kubereka kunowiriridza: kamwe ne kamwe masvondo 2–3
3 — Kusundidzira — mwana abekerwa
4 — Ganda rinobuda

*Enda kuchipatara NEKUKURUMIDZA kana:
• Mvura yaputika asati asvika masvondo 37
• Ropa rakawanda chero nguva
• Mwana akarega kusimudza
• Kurwadziwa kukuru kwazvo

Bereka nguva dzose kuchipatara — USAREGE KUBEREKA PAMBA WEGA.

*Zvokupereka kuchipatara:
• ANC card na ID
• Nguo nemabhanketi emwana
• Nguo dzako netshuwe
• Mari yekudzokera kumba

Uda kuziva nezve kuchengeta mwana mushure mekubereka?
responses.ndebele:
*Ukuzala*

*Izibonakaliso Zokuqala Ukuzala:*
• Ukuqaqamba ngokuqondile njalo njalo, kuqiniswa
• Amanzi ephuka — amanzi acwebileyo avela phansi
• Igazi elincane — ukhwehlela omhlophe ophuzayo noma obomvu
• Ubuhlungu obufayo emhlane ongezansi
• Uthando lokushintsha olunamandla

*Izigaba Zokuzala:*
1 — Ukuqala ukuzala: ukuqaqamba njalo njalo 5–10 amaminithi
2 — Ukuzala okusebenzayo: ukuqaqamba 2–3 amaminithi
3 — Ukushintsha — ingane iyazalwa
4 — Isibeleko sikhishwa

*Ya esibhedlela NGOKUSHESHA uma:
• Amanzi ephuka ngaphambi kwamasonto angu-37
• Igazi elinengi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi
• Ingane iyeka ukusimuka
• Ubuhlungu obufayo kakhulu

Yizala njalo esikhungweni sezempilo — UNGABI YEDWA EKHAYA.

*Lungisela isibhedlela:
• Ikhadi le-ANC lenombolo yakho
• Izingubo zengane lembesa
• Izingubo zakho letawula
• Imali yokubuyela ekhaya

Funa ukwazi ngokunakekela ingane ngemuva kokuzala?

patterns: how do i care for baby
what do i do after birth

responses.english:
*Newborn Care Guide*

*First Hours After Birth:*
• Skin-to-skin contact immediately with mother
• Start breastfeeding within 1 hour of birth
• Keep baby warm — kangaroo care works well
• Baby gets Vitamin K injection at birth

*Feeding:*
• Breastfeed exclusively for the first 6 months
• Feed on demand — 8 to 12 times per day
• No water, tea or formula is needed
• Breastfeed from both sides at each feed

*Cord Care:*
• Keep cord clean and dry at all times
• Do NOT put herbs, ash, mud or oil on cord
• Cord falls off in 7 to 10 days
• See a nurse if cord is red, smelly or wet

*Warning Signs — Go to Clinic:*
• Not feeding for 8 or more hours
• Yellow skin or eyes — jaundice
• Difficulty breathing or fast breathing
• High fever above 38°C
• Convulsions or shaking

*Vaccinations:*
• At birth: BCG, Polio
• 6 weeks: DPT, Hib, HepB, PCV
• 10 weeks: DPT, Hib, HepB, PCV
• 14 weeks: DPT, Hib, HepB, PCV, Polio

Would you like advice about HIV and PMTCT for your baby?
responses.shona:
*Ndiridziro Yekuchengeta Mwana Mutsva*

*Maawa Ekutanga Mushure Mekubereka:*
• Kubatana nezanda pemuviri pakarepo namai
• Tanga kuchengeta mazamu mukati memaawa ekutanga
• Chengetedza mwana kupisa — kangaroo care inoshanda
• Mwana anopiwira injection yaVitamin K pokuberekwa

*Kudyisa:*
• Chengeta mazamu chete kwemasvondo 6 ekutanga
• Chipishe nguva dzose — kamwe 8 kusvika 12 pazuva
• Hapana mvura, tii kana formula inodikanwa
• Chengeta mazamu ose maviri pachipiwa chega chega

*Kuchengeta tombo:*
• Chengeta tombo rakachena uye rakaoma nguva dzose
• USAISE mishonga yechivanhu, madota, dhaka kana mafuta patambo
• Tombo anodonha mazuva 7 kusvika 10
• Ona nesi kana tambo rina utsi, inonhuhwa kana inahukwa

*Zviratidzo Zvekuenda Kuchipatara:
• Kuramba kudyisa maawa 8 kana kupfuura
• Ganda kana meso akatsva — jaundice
• Kutadza kupfeka mweya kana kukurumidza
• Tembiricha yakakwira pamusoro pa 38°C
• Kurwadza kana kushamba

*Mabindu:
• Pokuberekwa: BCG, Polio
• Svondo 6: DPT, Hib, HepB, PCV
• Svondo 10: DPT, Hib, HepB, PCV
• Svondo 14: DPT, Hib, HepB, PCV, Polio

Uda mazano maHIV nePMTCT emwana wako?
responses.ndebele:
*Umhlahlandlela Wokunakekela Ingane Entsha*

*Amahora Okuqala Ngemuva Kokuzalwa:*
• Ukuxhumana kwesikhumba ngokushesha nonina
• Qala ukuncelisa ngaphakathi kwehora lokuqala
• Gcina ingane ifudumele — ukugqoka njengekangaro kusebenza kahle
• Ingane ithola umjovo we-Vitamin K ekuzalweni

*Ukuncelisa:*
• Ncelisa kuphela izinyanga eziyisithupha zokuqala
• Ncelisa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi — izikhathi 8 kuya ku-12 ngosuku
• Akunamanzi, itiye noma i-formula edingekayo
• Ncelisa ohlangothini lwebele ngakunye ekucimeni ngakunye

*Ukunakekela Intambo:
• Gcina intambo ihlanzekile futhi eyomile njalo
• UNGAFAKI imithombo, umlotha, udaka noma amafutha entambweni
• Intambo iyawa ezinsukwini ezingu-7 kuya ku-10
• Bonana lomeluleki wezempilo uma intambo ibomvu, inuka noma inomanzi

*Izibonakaliso Zoxakaza — Ya Esibhedlela:
• Ukuncelisa amahora angu-8 noma ngaphezulu
• Isikhumba noma amehlo aluhlaza — i-jaundice
• Ubunzima bokuphefumula noma ukuphefumula ngokushesha
• Ukushisa okuphezulu kwa-38°C
• Ukuqaqamba noma ukuthuthumela

*Imijovo:
• Ekuzalweni: i-BCG, i-Polio
• Izonto 6: i-DPT, i-Hib, i-HepB, i-PCV
• Izonto 10: i-DPT, i-Hib, i-HepB, i-PCV
• Izonto 14: i-DPT, i-Hib, i-HepB, i-PCV, i-Polio

Funa ulwazi nge-HIV ne-PMTCT yengane yakho?

responses.english:
*HIV and PMTCT*
*(Prevention of Mother to Child Transmission)*

*Every pregnant woman should:*
• Get tested for HIV at the first ANC visit
• Know your status — it protects you and your baby
• Get tested again at 36 weeks

*If you are HIV POSITIVE:*
• Start ART treatment immediately — do not wait
• Take ART every day without missing a dose
• Stay on treatment throughout pregnancy and breastfeeding
• Deliver at a health facility
• Your baby gets NVP drops for 6 weeks after birth
• Baby is tested at 6 weeks and 18 months

*With proper treatment:*
The risk of passing HIV to baby drops from 40% to less than 2%

*Breastfeeding with HIV:*
• You CAN breastfeed while on ART
• Exclusive breastfeeding for 6 months is recommended
• Continue ART throughout breastfeeding

*Partner testing:*
• Ask your partner to test too
• Couples testing is available at your clinic

All HIV services are FREE and CONFIDENTIAL at government clinics.

Do you have questions about ART treatment or breastfeeding with HIV?
responses.shona:
*HIV nePMTCT*
*(Kudzivirira Kutapurira Kubva Kuna Amai Kusvika Kuna Mwana)*

*Mukadzi wose ane mimba anofanira:
• Bvunzwa HIV pazushanyiro yekutanga yeANC
• Ziva mamiriro ako — inokudzivirira iwe nemwana wako
• Bvunzwa zvakare pasvondo 36

*Kana une HIV POSITIVE:
• Tanga mushonga weART nekukurumidza — usasamira
• Tora ART zuva rega rega usingasiye zuva
• Ramba uri pamishonga munguva yose yemimba uye kuchengeta mazamu
• Bereka kuchipatara
• Mwana wako anopiwira NVP mashama kwemasvondo 6
• Mwana anobvunzwa pasvondo 6 na pasvondo 18

*Nemishonga yakanaka:
Danjo rekutapurira HIV kubva kuna amai kusvika kuna mwana rinobuda kubva 40% kusvika pazasi pa 2%

*Kuchengeta mazamu une HIV:
• UNOGONA kuchengeta mazamu uri pamishonga weART
• Kuchengeta mazamu chete kwemasvondo 6 kunokurudzirwa
• Ramba uri pamishonga munguva yose yekuchengeta mazamu

*Bvunzo yemurume wako:
• Mukumbire murume wako kuzobvunzwa nawe
• Bvunzo dzamwe vaviri dzinowanikwa kuchipatara

Masevhisi ose eHIV HAANA MARI uye AKAVANZWA kuchipatara chehurumende.
responses.ndebele:
*I-HIV le-PMTCT*
*(Ukuvimbela Ukusabalalisa Kusuka Kunina Ukuya Enganeni)*

*Owesifazane okhulumayo wonke kufanele:
• Ukuhlolwa nge-HIV ekuvakasheni kwakuqala kwe-ANC
• Yazi isimo sakho — kuvikela wena lengane yakho
• Ukuhlolwa futhi emasvondweni angu-36

*Uma una i-HIV POSITIVE:
• Qala ukulashwa nge-ART ngokushesha — ungalindi
• Thatha i-ART njalo njalo ungazishiyi izigaba
• Hlala emithini ngesikhathi sonke sokulinda lokuncelisa
• Belethela esikhungweni sezempilo
• Ingane yakho ithola amathonsi e-NVP izinyanga eziyisithupha
• Ingane ihlolwa ngezonto eziyisithupha langezinyanga eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili

*Ngokulapha okufaneleyo:
Ingozi yokudlulisela ingane i-HIV isehla kusuka ku-40% iye phansi kuka-2%

*Ukuncelisa une i-HIV:
• UNGAKWENZA ukuncelisa usathatha i-ART
• Ukuncelisa kuphela izinyanga eziyisithupha kukhuthazwa
• Qhubeka nge-ART ngesikhathi sonke sokuncelisa

*Ukuhlolwa komlingani wakho:
• Cela umlingani wakho ukuze ahlolwe
• Ukuhlolwa kwezimbili kukhona esibhedlela

Imikhuba yonke ye-HIV MAHHALA futhi IYIMFIHLO ezikhungweni zezempilo zikaHulumeni.

responses.english:
EMERGENCY — PLEASE ACT NOW

Call your nearest clinic or Village Health Worker IMMEDIATELY.

Zimbabwe Emergency:
• Ambulance: 994 or 999
• Parirenyatwa Hospital: +263 4 794 411
• Sally Mugabe Hospital: +263 4 621 071

While waiting for help:
• Lie down on your left side
• Keep warm
• Send someone to get help
• Do not eat or drink

Do NOT delay. Maternal emergencies are life-threatening.

MamaBot cannot replace emergency medical care.
responses.shona:
NGOZI — ITAI ZVINO NEKUKURUMIDZA

Fona chipatara chiri pedyo kana VHW wako NEKUKURUMIDZA.

Nhamba dzeNgozi muZimbabwe:
• Ambulance: 994 kana 999
• Parirenyatwa Hospital: +263 4 794 411
• Sally Mugabe Hospital: +263 4 621 071

Uchimirira rubatsiro:
• Lala pasi divi rerudyi
• Zvichengete kupisa
• Tumira mumwe munhu kunotsvaga rubatsiro
• Usadya kana kunwa

USAMIRA. Zvinetso zvemimba zvine njodzi yemoyo.

MamaBot inogona kutsiva kurapwa kwechipatara.
responses.ndebele:
ISIMO ESIPHUTHUMAYO — YENZA MANJE NGOKUSHESHA

Shayela isibhedlela esiseduze noma uMsebenzi Wezempilo NGOKUSHESHA.

Izinombolo Eziphuthumayo eZimbabwe:
• I-Ambulance: 994 noma 999
• Parirenyatwa Hospital: +263 4 794 411
• Sally Mugabe Hospital: +263 4 621 071

Ulindile usizo:
• Lala phansi ohlangothini lwesandla sokhohlo
• Zifudumeze
• Thumela umuntu ukuyotholela usizo
• Ungadli noma uphuze

UNGALINDANGI. Izimo eziphuthumayo zokukhulelwa ziyingozi ekuphileni.

UMamaBot angeke asinde njengokunakekelwa ezibhedlela.
